name: Meridian Transit Authority Line Guard Full Kit
description: High-visibility amber and gunmetal grey modular armor shell over insulated transit-orange fatigues, stenciled with MTA's circular rail-and-lightning bolt crest on shoulder pauldrons and helmet visor housing. The helmet is a low-profile hard hat hybrid with integrated mesh comms and crowd-control strobe emitters at the temples. Load-bearing rig carries baton loops, zip-restraint pouches, and a compact fare-enforcement scanner clipped to the sternum. Steel-toed insulated boots handle both platform ice and chemical spills from the lower transit tunnels.
functionality: Crowd control integration, fare-enforcement scanning, cold-rated insulation for underground tunnel deployment, and strobe deterrent emitters.
what_it_says: The transit system has teeth — and you are currently standing between this officer and their quota.
manufacturer: Meridian Transit Authority Equipment Division / Stratum Logistics supply contract
story_hooks: A Line Guard's fare scanner keeps flagging a ghost passenger — someone riding the system with a transit ID that officially doesn't exist.
The kit's insulation hides a second lining sewn in by a previous owner — filled with folded pamphlets from a transit workers' strike movement.
